title: Detection Engineering
summary: Write the rules, parsers and tuning logic that turn synthetic logs, DNS and network traffic into alerts people can trust.
description: Detection engineering is the craft of turning raw telemetry into alerts. You will parse key=value logs, evaluate Sigma-style rules and boolean conditions, count events in sliding windows, tune out false positives with allowlists, extract indicators of compromise, flag DNS tunnelling, evaluate and audit firewall rules, match IDS-style payload signatures and stitch events into incidents. Every log, address and domain is synthetic (documentation address ranges and .test names), and every lesson asks for the defender's side: a rule, a filter or a report.
